chrome_1180_family._the_conflict: Decorative Line, Roster Group Header, Team Label and Small Header are recorded 1180 wide. 1280 - 1180 = 100, i.e. a 50px side margin — not the 69px margin the 3-column grid is built on (1280 - 1143 = 137, 69 left + 68 right). Both cannot be the grid.

_hypotheses.a_two_grids: The file ships two margin systems: 69 on the rail-based front-end pages, 50 on the list/roster/table pages. Consequence: UBRPageTitle/UBRRosterHeader/UBRRule get their own 50-margin anchor set and the generator needs a second grid constant.
_hypotheses.b_stale_layer: The 1180 chrome is an older layer that the shipping screens do not instance. Consequence: delete 1180 from the spec, author list chrome at 1143 on the 69 grid, one grid everywhere.

_verify: Read the Roster Group Header INSTANCE inside 927:43283 (not the component main) and record its absolute x and width. x=50 w=1180 proves hypothesis (a). x=69 w=1143 proves (b) and the 1180 is the artboard only. Anything else is a third answer and is more valuable than either.
Do the same for Decorative Line, Team Label and Small Header on the same screen — if they disagree with each other the answer is 'stale layer' regardless.

Check whether the 1180 elements are children of a 1180-wide parent frame that is itself centred at x=50 — that would make 1180 a local coordinate space and dissolve the conflict entirely. Check this FIRST; it is the cheapest explanation and the doc's measurements may be local rather than absolute.
Record the y of the header on RS_Friends at the same time — it also settles the UBRPageTitle 75/105 question above.
